sticker_location: On the inside of the furnace's lower door, with the filter size printed on the old filter's frame.

problems.title: Heat or AC won't come on

plan.diagnosis: Most no-heat calls are the thermostat: dead batteries, the wrong mode, or a setting below the room temperature. The next is the furnace's own power switch, which looks like a light switch and gets flipped off by accident.
safety: If you smell gas, leave the house now and call the gas company from outside.

steps.instruction: Check the thermostat is on HEAT (or COOL)
details: Set it 5 degrees above the room for heat, below for AC.
steps.check: It shows HEAT and a target above the room temperature.

steps.instruction: Blank screen? Put in fresh batteries
details: Pull the cover straight off; most take two AA or AAA.

steps.instruction: Make sure the furnace switch is ON
details: It looks like a light switch, often with a red plate.
steps.check: The switch near the furnace is up (on).

details: Furnaces wait a few minutes before they fire.
steps.check: You hear it start and feel air from the vents.

rig_beats.caption: It should start in a few minutes

problems.cause: the thermostat or a switched-off furnace

problems.title: Weak air or the house won't warm up
symptoms: The AC runs but it's not cooling well
Time to change the furnace filter
Still not heating with the thermostat set right

plan.diagnosis: A clogged air filter starves the system of air, so it blows weakly, runs all day and can shut itself off. Filters should be changed every 1 to 3 months. A new one costs a few dollars and takes two minutes.
replacement_parts: Air filter, the same size as the old one

details: So it doesn't pull dust while the filter is out.

steps.instruction: Slide the old filter out of its slot
details: The slot is low on the side of the furnace, or behind a grille on a wall or ceiling.

steps.instruction: Check the size printed on its frame
details: A gray, dusty filter is overdue.

steps.instruction: Slide the new one in, arrow toward the furnace
details: The arrow shows which way the air flows.
steps.check: The filter is all the way in and the arrow points into the furnace.

details: Write the date on the filter's frame.
steps.check: Air from the vents feels strong.

rig_beats.caption: Size and arrow are printed here
